title_zh: 城市纠错权与同渠道恢复协议
title_en: Urban Correction Rights and Same-channel Recovery Protocol
public_test_zh: 一条错误如果不能沿原渠道被纠正，这项AI服务就不能留在京张。
public_test_en: If an error cannot be corrected through every channel that carried it, the AI service must not remain in Jing-Zhang.
core_judgement_zh: 百年京张的现代性不只是一组铁路意象，而是一套可测量、可交接、可维护、出错后可检修的公共工程制度。JZAC把这套制度转译为AI时代的证据、责任、纠错与恢复空间。
core_judgement_en: The modernity of the century-old Jing-Zhang Railway is not a visual railway motif but a public-works discipline of measurement, handover, maintenance and repair. JZAC translates that discipline into spaces for AI evidence, responsibility, correction and recovery.

verification_layers.boundary: Provenance evidence does not by itself prove factual truth.
The proposal does not create a universal automated truth score.
A correction that exists only in the backend does not pass.

evidence_southbound: Zhongzhiyuan failure test and bounded evidence
AI Origin public interpretation and contest
correction_northbound: harm or error reported at the point of use
retest, procurement update and product revision

pilot_a_three_area_relay.action_zh: 无屏受理、原渠道清点、人工暂停、独立事实复核与公众可见更正
pilot_a_three_area_relay.action_en: screenless intake, channel inventory, human pause, independent fact review and public correction

pilot_a_three_area_relay.action_zh: 把误标转成产品与发布流程的失效重测任务
pilot_a_three_area_relay.action_en: convert the mislabel into a failure retest for the product and publishing workflow

pilot_a_three_area_relay.action_zh: 更新采购证据、执行退出测试并确认空间与数据恢复
pilot_a_three_area_relay.action_en: update procurement evidence, test exit and confirm spatial and data recovery

authority_limits: provenance, detection and human judgement remain separate
